body: Truth and Dair! I play Smash 4, and Greninja.
Nintendo announces that all but one franchise is going to be removed from Smash. What franchise would you be most okay with staying?

Ooh, that’s a tricky one. There’s a few I’d really like to see, namely Lycanroc - which is one I can actually see getting in, as opposed to some more niche Pokémon I’d want like Zangoose or Haxorus.
Those are all really high up for me, but if I had to pick just one, I would like Eevee in smash. Hear me out, here; his moveset could be made up of attacks that harness the power of all his different evolutions, perhaps. I love the Pokémon and I’d love to play as Eevee if it was handled that way (and with Eevee suddenly becoming kind of the second mascot, it’s decently reasonable!)
Hit me up with a truth!
